timeline.summary: JK Lakshmi Cement executed a Mining Lease Transfer Deed for a 100.34-hectare limestone block in Satna, Madhya Pradesh.
JK Lakshmi Cement gets ₹1.79 Cr GST demand plus penalty of ₹1.79 Cr for FY24
JK Lakshmi Cement Limited’s conference call hosted by PhillipCapital (India) Pvt. Ltd. on 21st May 2026 at 4:00 P.M. IST was recorded and accessible via the provided link and ID.
JK Lakshmi Cement hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 21, 2026, discussing demand outlook and cost pressures.
Bengal & Assam Company Ltd. and its promoter group declared no encumbrances on JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd. shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
JK Lakshmi Cement approved acquiring 26% stakes in solar SPVs DynoSpark and Elevate Solar Energy for up to ₹24 Cr total for captive power.
